caption: The drawing depicts a statue of a person standing on a rectangular base. The figure is shown wearing a long, buttoned coat, trousers, and boots. The person has a large hat with a prominent brim and plume. The left arm is extended straight out and slightly upwards, with the index finger pointing outward. The right arm is bent at the elbow, and the hand is holding a long, conical horn or trumpet-like object to the mouth. The figure has defined facial features, wavy hair, and sideburns. The drawing is executed in grayscale tones, with detailed shading indicating the folds of the clothing and the three-dimensional form of the statue. The background is plain and lightly shaded, with a thin rectangular border around the composition. In the bottom left corner, there is a small scale indicating measurement units, and in the lower right corner, there is a signature reading "Bernard Kreshmarott."
title: Wooden Figure
